tx:
Creating summoning pouches. Unlike other rocks, the chance of a rock is given per pouch and not per action.
For best chances of obtaining the rock per pouch made, it is best to create pouches at the obelisk in Amlodd district during the Voice of Seren.
It is recommended to make cheap pouches if summoning experience is not needed (saving more expensive ones for Double XP). For example making summoning familiars that are made with a cheap secondary item. Bringing materials for 100-200 pouches should be enough to get the golden rocks.
This method consists of selling the noted secondary items to the NPC beside the obelisk and buying them back, as the NPC will un-note the items, reducing the need to bank. The player then crafts the pouches and trades them in to the NPC for spirit shards, then rinse and repeat.
Also magic notepaper can be used to save the pouches made instead of trading them in.
